items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: You don't remember Recafo? ... Oh, Recafo, yeah. ... That's my home, Recafo.

ctx.x: Well, it depends. Tell him it depends. He said it depends.

Yeah. Yeah. And then he's a Recafo, you know. Yeah. Huh? Well, the king that said Recafo was a kind of father too, you know. That's what they say, but he's better. Me and his brother, and I tell him his brother said he was half Italian and French. Recafo. You don't remember Recafo?
He was a big man here. I don't remember.
